en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tranquil riverside or coastal inlet with a small rowboat on the water, rocky banks, lush vegetation, and a hill crowned by tall cypress trees and buildings in the background. The card has printed Greek and French captions at the bottom describing the view of Ypsos near the sea in Corfu, as well as a vertical Greek inscription on the left and a circular postal cancellation on the right. There is a large handwritten signature in purple ink across the lower part of the image.
